quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #6
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: You must stop at an intersection when you see a:
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop completely, look both ways, and only go when it is safe.

questions.question: A steady yellow traffic light means a ____ light will come next.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means a steady red light will appear soon.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means you cannot do that action. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time with no signs or signals, who has the right-of-way?

options.text: The car approaching from the right has the right-of-way.
The car approaching from the left has the right-of-way.
The car in which the driver sounds his horn first has the right-of-way.
The car that is traveling the fastest has the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: The car approaching from the right has the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: When two cars arrive at an intersection at the same time with no traffic control, the car on the right goes first.

questions.question: Your wheels slip off the edge of the road. You should:

options.text: Jerk the steering wheel to force the vehicle back onto the pavement.
Speed up and steer back onto the pavement gradually.
Slam on your brakes and stop.
Slow down gently using the brakes. Turn the steering wheel to get back on the pavement at a safe speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down gently using the brakes. Turn the steering wheel to get back on the pavement at a safe speed.
questions.explanation: If your wheels leave the road, slow down gently with the brakes. When you are going slow enough, turn the steering wheel to get back on the road. Do not jerk the wheel or turn sharply.

questions.question: You are waiting to turn left at a busy intersection and cannot see past the other cars. You should:

options.text: Go quickly when the first lane clears.
Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
Wait for an oncoming driver to wave you across.
Move into each lane as it clears.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see all the lanes you need to cross before turning.
questions.explanation: Never start a left turn until you can see that all the lanes you need to cross are clear and it is safe to turn.

questions.question: What is the only way to reduce your blood alcohol concentration (BAC)?

options.text: Wait for time to pass so your body can get rid of the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait for time to pass so your body can get rid of the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce your BAC. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers can help you stay awake, but they do not lower your BAC or make you sober.

questions.question: Before you pass another vehicle, you should signal:

options.text: Early so other drivers know what you plan to do.

questions.correctAnswerText: Early so other drivers know what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: Signal early so other drivers can see your plans in advance.

questions.question: Your wheels drop off the pavement onto the shoulder. You should:

options.text: Brake hard and turn sharply back onto the pavement.
Stop your car on the edge of the road.
Slow down and carefully turn back onto the pavement.
Keep your speed and turn sharply back onto the pavement.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and carefully turn back onto the pavement.
questions.explanation: Slow down without hard braking and carefully turn back onto the road. Check for other traffic before getting back on the road.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.explanation: Shaded areas under trees or buildings freeze faster than other parts of the road in cold weather. These areas also dry slower.

questions.question: When driving in rain, what lights should you use?
questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when it is raining.

questions.question: When entering a street from a driveway, what must you do?

options.text: Drive slowly to give approaching vehicles and pedestrians time to move.
Honk your horn so approaching vehicles and pedestrians know you are coming.
Stop and make sure no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching before you enter.
Ignore pedestrians if there is no sidewalk.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and make sure no pedestrians or vehicles are approaching before you enter.
questions.explanation: Always stop before entering the street from a driveway. Yield to any approaching vehicles or pedestrians. You must stop before crossing the sidewalk. Failing to stop is against the law.

questions.question: When driving at night and another vehicle is coming toward you, your headlights should be on:
questions.explanation: Do not use high beam headlights when another vehicle is approaching or when you are following another vehicle at night. Use low beam to keep everyone safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does a single dashed yellow line between traffic lanes mean?

options.text: You may pass if it is safe
Both lanes go in the same direction
You may pass even if it is dangerous

questions.correctAnswerText: You may pass if it is safe
questions.explanation: Yellow lines separate traffic going in opposite directions. A single dashed yellow line means drivers in both directions may pass. You can only pass if it is safe and you will not interfere with oncoming traffic.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear
You do not need to signal

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear
questions.explanation: Before passing, check that the passing lane is clear and use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: What should you do at a flashing yellow light?

options.text: Slow down and proceed with care
Stop and wait for a green light
Stop and proceed when the way is clear

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and proceed with care
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means caution. Slow down, look, and proceed carefully.

questions.question: As alcohol builds up in your blood, what happens?

options.text: Your body breaks it down faster

questions.explanation: As alcohol builds up in your system, your reactions slow down. You feel more confident and make more errors while driving.

questions.question: Which of these distractions increase the risk of a crash?
questions.explanation: Using a cell phone, radio, or CD player while driving is dangerous and increases crash risk. This is true even with hands-free phones.

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?

options.text: Do not speed on wet roads
Keep tires at proper air pressure

questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when your tires slide on water. Low tire pressure, worn tread, and speeding all increase hydroplaning risk.

questions.question: Which statement is true about driving on a wet road?

options.text: Faster speeds make your tires less effective.
Good tires are not affected by water.
Deep water is safer than shallow water.
Slower speeds make the road more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: Faster speeds make your tires less effective.
questions.explanation: When you drive faster on a wet road, your tires cannot remove water as well. If you go too fast, your tires lose grip and you hydroplane — you slide on a layer of water.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a person is ahead directing traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: When entering an interstate from an on-ramp, a driver should:

options.text: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
Assume other drivers will move for them.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to drivers already on the interstate.
questions.explanation: When entering the interstate from an on-ramp, you must yield to traffic already on the highway. Merge safely when it is possible.

questions.question: When a traffic light turns green, you should:

options.text: Speed up as fast as possible.
Wait for another driver to wave you on.

questions.explanation: A green light means you can proceed through the intersection. However, you must first let pedestrians and other traffic finish crossing.

questions.question: You must stop for a school bus:

options.text: That is parked on the shoulder with no one in it.
When it approaches you, even without flashing lights.
On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
Whenever the driver waves at you.

questions.correctAnswerText: On a two-lane road when its red lights are flashing.
questions.explanation: Stop when you see a school bus with flashing red lights. On a two-lane road, traffic in both directions must stop while the red lights are flashing and the stop arm is extended.

questions.question: Regulatory signs are usually ____ and must always be obeyed.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are usually white with black markings. They control traffic and must always be obeyed.

questions.question: Emergency vehicles:

options.text: Have the right-of-way when using sirens and flashing lights.
May use a loudspeaker to give instructions.

questions.explanation: Yield to emergency vehicles using sirens or horns and flashing lights. Follow any instructions they give over their loudspeaker. Emergency vehicles often follow each other, so only proceed when the way is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that bicycles may be in the area.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.explanation: Stop signs have an eight-sided shape called an octagon. This shape is used only for stop signs.

questions.question: A diamond-shaped sign:

options.text: Alerts drivers to food and gas locations.

questions.explanation: Diamond-shaped signs warn of hazards ahead. They are usually yellow or orange.

questions.question: What must a driver do when approaching a flashing red traffic signal?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means stop. You must yield to all traffic and pedestrians before proceeding. At railroad crossings, a flashing red light means a train is coming. Wait until the lights stop flashing and all warning devices turn off before crossing.

questions.question: What must a driver do when an emergency vehicle approaches with its siren and/or flashing lights?

options.text: Pull to the right and stop.
Pull to the right and slow down.
Pull to the right and turn on their vehicle's four-way flashers.
Stop and let the emergency vehicle pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull to the right and stop.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle uses its lights and sirens, move immediately to the right side of the road and stop.

questions.question: Highway signs that tell drivers about dangerous conditions are called:
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert drivers to possible hazards ahead. Always follow warning signs for your safety. Ignoring a warning sign can cause an accident.

questions.question: How should you safely pass a bicycle?

options.text: Honk at the bicyclist to let them know you're trying to pass.
Drive in the bicycle lane until you get a chance to pass.
Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
Rush ahead to pull in front of the bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and give them as much space as possible.
questions.explanation: Slow down and give bicyclists plenty of space. Bicyclists have less protection than car drivers. Passing too fast or too close can cause them to lose control.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is coming. Watch for traffic crossing your path.
